content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The final decision rejects Claim 1 because Complainant did not report the slurs before EEO contact, and rejects Claim 2 for no retaliatory animus, but neither conclusion is traced to the conflicting witness accounts, and the Threat Assessment Committee report and LT2's photographs are not in the file."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most statements are attributed to named officials (Complainant, CO1, CO2, LT1, LT2, CAPT, HRM), but the Threat Assessment Committee's conclusion is known only through CAPT's testimony, the photographs are unattributed in the file, and CAPT said he could not recall whether pictures were taken."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Many events are dated (Nov 17 and 23, 2022; Jan 2, Jan 9, Mar 2-3, Apr 10 and Aug 3, 2023), but the dates of CO2's reassignment, the reminder letters, the Threat Assessment Committee's findings and the AWOL coding are missing, and the narrative is not strictly in order."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The Threat Assessment Committee's membership and criteria are not identified, the record does not show who decided on the AWOL coding, welfare check or medical requests, and the final decision does not show how the denials and Complainant's responses were weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"An independent reviewer could not assess the conclusion without the missing Threat Assessment Committee documentation, the photographs and the reasoning linking evidence to findings, so the record does not stand on its own."}}}
